description.text: The frame opens almost entirely black. Only a faint, cool sheen traces the edge of carbon fibre bodywork, enough to suggest a low, wide shape hidden in the dark. A deep room tone fills the large empty showroom, and the polished concrete floor catches the first hint of reflected light. The black sports car eases forward out of the shadow. Its low nose and wheel arches emerge first, matte-dark surfaces gaining definition as a soft headlight glow spills ahead of the vehicle and slides across the floor. The movement is smooth and deliberate, with the car advancing a short distance before its tyres begin to slow over the concrete. The camera holds a static shot throughout, keeping the showroom's clean, uncluttered space and the car's low silhouette centered in the composition. As the car settles, the carbon fibre bodywork catches a restrained sheen, the wheel arches and front splitter resolve more clearly, and the headlight glow comes to rest across the polished floor. A low tyre hiss fades as the vehicle stops. At the five-second endpoint, the black sports car stands on the empty showroom floor in the exact position, scale, and arrangement of the complete supplied final-frame image. The full frame is preserved at that anchor, including its layout, background, subject placement, and lighting, with no cropping, panel extraction, or redrawn composition.
